opening-0: Long ago, a great light shone from the tallest tower on the island: the Great Beacon.
opening-1: Queen Amara was Deaf. When she signed, her hands began to glow. She called the light Signlight.
opening-2: She taught everyone who wanted to learn. They became the Signkeepers, and Signlight flowed through every signing hand.
opening-3: But one Signkeeper wanted ALL the light for himself. His name was Malgrath.
opening-4: One night, he shattered the Beacon. Eight Beacon Shards flew across the land.
opening-5: Wherever a shard fell, the creatures turned wild and grumpy. They became Hexbound.
opening-6: Only one young apprentice escaped the Signkeeper Academy that night... You.
zone-meadow-0: The Meadow. Farmers grew sunflowers here, and kids flew kites over Sprout Pond.
zone-meadow-1: Then a Beacon Shard splashed into the pond. The Croak King swallowed its light, and his croak turned every critter purple.
zone-meadow-2: The first shard is waiting somewhere in this meadow.
zone-forest-0: The Forest, where Professor Hoot taught young Signkeepers under the tallest pines.
zone-forest-1: A shard crashed through the branches. Now Professor Hoot is Hexbound, and the woods have gone dark and quiet.
zone-forest-2: His old lessons are still hidden in these trees.
zone-caves-0: The Caves. Every sound echoes, and crystals glow in the dark.
zone-caves-1: Count Flap carried a shard deep underground. Its light keeps him awake, grumpy, and hexed.
zone-caves-2: Stay close to your buddies. It's dark down here.
zone-river-0: The River once sparkled with Signlight, all the way from the great waterfall to the sea.
zone-river-1: Inkzilla dragged a shard under the falls and turned the whole river gray with hexed ink.
zone-river-2: Fishers, sailors, and a bridgekeeper with riddles all need a Signkeeper's help.
zone-castle-0: The Signkeeper Academy. Your old school, in ruins.
zone-castle-1: Blaze, the Academy's gentle dragon, now guards a shard for Malgrath. The school is his fortress.
zone-castle-2: Somewhere in the ruins, your old classmates are hiding.
zone-keep-0: Crown Keep, Queen Amara's castle, in the very heart of the island.
zone-keep-1: Malgrath sealed the Queen behind hexed glass, and turned her loyal gryphon Aurelion into his guard.
zone-keep-2: The Queen is still inside, waiting to be set free.
zone-spires-0: The Crystal Spires. Three shards streaked through the portal and froze among the stars.
zone-spires-1: The Glacier Wyrm curled around one of them. Its icy breath froze the whole realm.
zone-spires-2: Stay warm, Signkeeper. And keep signing.
zone-clouds-0: The Cloud Kingdom, floating above a sea of stars.
zone-clouds-1: The Storm Owl guards a shard inside a thunderstorm that never ends.
zone-clouds-2: Every flash of lightning is Malgrath, watching you.
zone-void-0: The Void Rift, where the light ends.
zone-void-1: Malgrath waits at the very top with the last shard... and Rook's little sister, Robin.
zone-void-2: This is it. Everything you've learned leads here.
